newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-ISRAEL LABOUR TO WORLD CUP WIN OVER LUXEMBOURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ISRAEL LABOUR TO WORLD CUP WIN OVER LUXEMBOURG.

text.p: Israel kept alive their hopes of qualifying for the 1998 World Cup finals when they laboured to a 1-0 home win over Luxembourg in European group five on Sunday.
The win carried them into second place in the group behind Russia. Both teams have seven points but the Russians have played one game fewer.

Veteran striker Eli Ohana scored the all important goal five minutes before half time, slotting the ball home after Luxembourg goalkeeper Paul Koch had fumbled a cross from the left by debutant midfielder Yossi Abuksis.
Luxembourg failed to mount a serious challenge on the Israeli goal and Itzik Kornfein, also making his first appearance for his country, was barely tested.
They have yet to win a point after three qualifying matches.
